request: Robert requested broader UK construction SME discipline research, covering domestic and commercial contractors, while reviewing optional setup suggestions.

sources.basis: ONS industry structure and business-register coverage. Great Britain, VAT/PAYE registered firms; not all UK businesses or all unregistered sole traders.

Located published firm-size/trade data as the appropriate starting point for frequency ranking. Latest listed edition2024, released19February2026. Workbook was not analysed: web parser unsupported XLSX and direct public download returned403; no bypass attempted.
Construction SIC activities include commercial/domestic building, civil engineering, demolition, installation and completion trades. Classifications are not a ranked user-facing menu.
Industry terminology includes drylining, suspended ceilings, partitioning, plastering, steel framing and site carpentry/joinery.
Fit-out/refurbishment work spans homes, offices, hospitals, schools, hotels and retail. Supports sector-neutral wording rather than domestic-only suggestions.

limits: Initial primary-source research, not a representative survey of SME websites or statistically verified UK top15. No company data collected, no app/hosted/provider operations, no trade mapping or new field adopted.
designRecommendation: Keep free text primary. Present optional suggestions as equal-width aligned rectangular tiles with restrained corners, even gaps, green selected states and keyboard focus. Do not mix discipline with domestic/commercial customer sector. Final count/labels/order remain proposals pending frequency validation and owner review; preserve landscaping/fencing/kitchen specialisms via free text or later reviewed suggestions, not silent removal of feedback.

rightPanelProposal.heading: Built around the work you do.
rightPanelProposal.statement: Start with the essentials. Add your story and examples when you are ready.
items: Describe your business: your words, not a rigid category.
Make it yours: your trading name on your proposals.
Start with the essentials: add your company story and examples later.
Move into your first job: build a brief and a clear price.
rightPanelProposal.status: Proposed copy only. Same right-hand layout/typography/four-row structure, context changes by stage. No unsupported automatic tailoring or AI claim.
